# Payroll Splitter Demo by P-Devs

> Interactive portfolio demo for splitting USD and PHP payroll by hours rendered.

## Canonical URL

- [Open the demo](https://payroll-demo.pauuu.dev/)
- [Visit the P-Devs portfolio](https://pauuu.dev/)

## Demo behavior

- Calculations run entirely in the browser.
- Visitor-entered values reset when the page is refreshed and during the daily demo reset.
- Do not enter real or sensitive payroll information.
